_source: Core Rulebook, Druid (d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/druid/, read 2026-10-05) and Beast Shape I and II (d20pfsrd.com/magic/all-spells/b/beast-shape/, read 2026-10-05).
_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. The engine reads these fields and never these names.

abilities.name: Wild Shape
abilities.source: CRB p.51 Wild Shape: from 4th, as beast shape I (a Small or Medium animal); from 6th as beast shape II (Tiny or Large too); 1 hour per druid level; a standard action to change or change back. Beast shape I: Small +2 size Dex and +1 natural armour, Medium +2 size Str and +2 natural armour. Beast shape II: Tiny +4 size Dex, -2 Str, +1 natural armour; Large +4 size Str, -2 Dex, +4 natural armour. The form's natural attacks.
abilities.text: Become an animal for an hour a level — name it in brackets.
abilities.tell: {name}'s body folds into the shape of an animal.
not_yet: Elemental body (6th, 8th, 10th, 12th), plant shape (8th on), and beast shape III's Diminutive and Huge animals (8th).
The form's movement (climb, fly, swim) and senses (darkvision, low-light vision, scent).
Gear melding is the armour and shield bonuses only (Actor._melded_gear, 2026-10-06): an item that must be activated still works in the shape.
Casting while shaped is not refused (the book needs Natural Spell for it).
At will at 20th: the pool still counts uses.
